sample_unit: MCQ items (50, three runs) plus 13 public-education questions

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to chikungunya public-education questions versus sixth-grade benchmark
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across models (p < 0.05). DeepSeek-V3.2 was easiest and Gemini most complex, and no model met the sixth-grade benchmark.
links.quote: Deepseek-V3.2 produced the easiest text on average, Gemini the most complex, and no model met the sixth-grade benchmark.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini) on medical accuracy, information quality metrics, and readability for chikungunya public health queries without testing a deployment practice.
